Version 4 is a full rewrite. Go instead of Python, and it has a window now.

Version 3 worked fine, but it was a console app you configured with command-line flags and retyped them on every launch. That was always the worst part of using it. So: real settings screens, it remembers what you picked, and it sits in the system tray while you play. Close the window and your presence keeps running.

You can edit the presence text yourself now, which is the thing I'd wanted for the longest. Every phase gets its own template, in client through in game, with a preview next to the editor so you can see what Discord will show before you save it. Leave it all alone and it reads exactly like it always did.

Updates handle themselves from here. New versions download in the background, get their signature checked, and wait until you feel like restarting. You can read the changelog before you do. This should be the last time you download an exe by hand.

Nothing got dropped in the move, by the way: summoner icons, rank emblems, KDA and creep score, champion skins including the animated ultimates, TFT companions, Arena, spectating. All still there.

⚠️ **Coming from version 3?** Delete your old `leagueRPC.exe`. If both are running they fight over the same Discord presence, and the result just looks like a bug.
